title: The CEO is on the phone. Sort of.
scenario: You receive a call that sounds exactly like the CEO, including familiar speech patterns. They say an acquisition is confidential and instruct you to send a large payment before the market opens.

answers.A: Ask a second authorized executive to confirm the transaction before doing anything.
answers.B: Proceed because the voice, confidential context and timing match a real acquisition rumor inside the company.
answers.C: Pause and verify the request through established payment approvals and a separate known channel to the CEO/executive team.

explanation: Voice cloning can reproduce tone and cadence. High-value decisions need process-based authentication, not voice familiarity.
proTip: A convincing voice is not a second approver.
